content.value: An automobile at rest is passed by a truck travelling at a constant speed of 54 km/h. The automobile starts and accelerates for 10s at a constant rate until it reaches a speed of 90 km/h. If the automobile then maintains a constant speed of 90 km/h, determine when and where will it overtake the truck, assuming that the automobile starts (i) just as the truck passes, (ii) 3s after the truck has passed it.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 2nd Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2022
